methods.name: Intersection of OBIA and PBA results with refinement
methods.summary: The method involves performing both pixel-based (PBA) and object-based (OBIA) classification using the Random Forest algorithm, then intersecting the results to identify the most probable landslide extent. This is followed by post-processing refinement: removing small elongated objects (< 500 m2) and applying a median filter (6x6 window) to fill small holes.
methods.verbatim: Additionally, taking advantage of various processing approaches (pixels vs. object), the final detection map was generated for overlapped results from PBA and OBIA. Then, additional refinement was carried out (see Section 4.6).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked and accessible, and other input datasets are either linked or practically accessible via public providers. The custom code used for the intersection and refinement method is not provided or linked.
